original_question: Is the truck near the building?
entry_point: Normal footage page in desktop Edge on the prepared Windows laptop. The reviewer chose the left vehicle and separately requested a visual comparison using the privacy-processed frame.
review: The pickup occupies the left foreground. Buildings appear in the distant skyline. The first response claimed physical proximity without a measurement. The revised interaction explains the missing depth measurement locally, then answers an explicitly image-only question if the reviewer asks for it. Both cited evidence items were inspected on frame 103.
